title: event
description: One event of the project journal, a subset of the CloudEvents 1.0 JSON format. One journal line is one event.

id.description: Event id: 32 lowercase hex digits (uuid4 hex); the idempotency key of a subscriber.

source.description: The module that emitted the event.

type.description: Event type <module>.<subject>.<verb>; the first segment is the module of source.

time.description: When the event was written (UTC, milliseconds).

subject.description: What the event is about, inside its source (for example a plan item).

datacontenttype.description: Media type of data; always JSON.

dataschema.description: Schema of data, when its owner publishes one.

data.description: Payload as a JSON object; at most 65536 bytes of canonical JSON (checked by emit). Large or binary data travels as an artifact-ref.

traceparent.description: W3C trace context of the emitting operation.

causationid.description: Id of the event that caused this one.

correlationid.description: Id that ties a chain of events together (a run, a plan).

^(?!(?:data|project)$)[a-z0-9]{1,20}$.description: Unknown CloudEvents extension attribute; readers ignore it.
